title: About
paragraphs: My name is Jennifer Niu, I am a multidisciplinary artist working across digital media, animation, and design. I love to explore narratives through abstraction, technology, and visual storytelling, drawing inspiration from my daily life and reducing them into simple shapes and colors.

During my time at the University of Michigan, through my art, I aim to build immersive worlds that invite viewers to engage with familiar themes in new and unexpected ways. I am passionate about pushing the boundaries of traditional art forms by incorporating modern techniques and tools, creating pieces that are both visually striking and conceptually rich.
